question_text: Outline how a system virtual machine lets a research laptop run a guest operating system.
adaptation_rationale: Virtualization is explicitly an OS function; adapt to a system VM to avoid unselected Java detail. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Software presents virtual hardware to a guest OS; the guest executes in an environment managed on the host hardware.

marking_points.criterion: Guest OS runs using host resources managed by virtualization.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct answers meeting the same scoped requirement; valid alternative algorithms accepted where they meet any explicit question constraints.
partial_credit_notes: Award each specified criterion independently up to the allocation. Credit correct method after an earlier slip when consistent; do not award the same point twice.
